X01.desc_en: Prespecified, routinized data exchange or reporting mechanisms between human and veterinary health authorities.
X01.desc_zh: 人医与兽医部门之间预先设定、常态化的狂犬病数据交换或通报机制。

X02.title_zh: 人暴露触发动物端响应
X02.desc_en: Human bite or exposure incident report operationally triggers veterinary investigation, animal quarantine, observation, or testing.
X02.desc_zh: 人暴露或狂犬病疑似病例报告直接触发兽医部门开展咬伤动物追踪、隔离观察或采样检测。

X03.title_en: Animal Results Feed Back to Human Health
X03.title_zh: 动物检出反馈人医部门
X03.desc_en: Laboratory-confirmed animal rabies diagnosis or field signal is systematically fed back to public health services for human risk management or PEP.
X03.desc_zh: 动物实验室确诊或疑似狂犬病信号系统性反馈至公共卫生部门，指导暴露人群后处置或风险评估。

X04.title_zh: 国家级整合信息载体/联席报表
X04.desc_en: Joint One Health surveillance bulletin, integrated zoonoses dashboard, or shared intersectoral report encompassing both human and animal surveillance.
X04.desc_zh: 包含人与动物监测数据的国家联合公报、人兽共患病整合仪表板或联席监测专报。
